This is a best-effort assembly: I worked it out from the part outlines and could not check it against the grader, so some attachment points are judgement calls.

**Base and pillar.** The base stays upright, shifted to x = 454, y = 616. The pillar stands on top of it with its round head up. The head centre sits at the beam pivot (688, 108). The seat on the base is a guess at its top centre. I set it at the top of the middle block (local y = 5) rather than the lower platform at y ≈ 20, so the pillar could sit about 15 px off if the real seat is the platform.

**Beam.** The beam arches upward, with its centre hub at the pillar head (688, 108). Its two round ends then sit level at about y = 144, roughly 260 px either side of the pivot.

**Pointer.** The pointer's pin circle goes on the same pivot, with the long tip hanging straight down.

**Stirrups.** The small eye of each stirrup is pinned at a beam end, and the U-shaped yoke hangs below as a seat for the pan. The left and right stirrups are mirror images of each other, so each needs its own rotation. The yoke seat height along the bar was my estimate, so it is the least certain connection.

**Pans.** Each pan is rotated until its rim is level and its body sits below the rim. The pan's central boss lands on the yoke seat at about y = 401.
